resources.string: Choose what happens when power returns
Boot quietly and stay asleep. Wake with the remote.
Start normally. The box may turn on the TV over HDMI-CEC.
When power returns, Android boots quietly into sleep. Press Power on the remote to wake the box.
When power returns, the box starts normally and may turn on the connected TV.
Saving a mode does not restart the box. It applies at the next cold start.
Changes are disabled. Version 1.0 supports only RockTek RT-G2, Android 14, build 7475 with the exact verified firmware.
Changes are disabled because the boot script differs from the verified profile. No settings have been overwritten.
After power returns, Android will boot into sleep without its usual TV activation. You can wake the box with the remote. The box will not restart now.
Restore the original boot script for build 7475. After power returns, the box will start normally and may turn on the TV. The box will not restart now.
Do not disconnect power if this happened while saving. Keep the box running and check the details below before trying again.

Two startup modes for RockTek RT-G2. Uses the firmware’s SystemControl service without root. No network access or background service. Quiet start boots Android into sleep; it does not prevent the processor from starting. Uninstalling this app does not undo the selected mode. Future firmware updates may reset or change this configuration.
